purpose: Screen terrain variables as possible direct depth-responsive signals and as surface/slope confounders before any replacement model is fitted.

source.dem_combination: pixelwise median of all overlapping returned 10 m 3DEP seamless items

features.tpi_50m_m: elevation minus 11x11 local mean (approximately 50 m radius)
features.curvature_laplacian_per_m: sum of second horizontal derivatives of elevation

direct_depth_screen.candidate_rule: same full-separation direction must pass at both 10 m and 20 m inward buffers
direct_depth_screen.interpretation: Exploratory candidate only; six plots cannot validate a transferable numerical depth model.

surface_confounder_screen.rule: top_surface minus outslope must have the same nonzero sign for all three matched-depth pairs at each buffer, and the sign must agree across both buffers
surface_confounder_screen.interpretation: Consistent terrain separation by surface type is evidence of confounding, not depth.

forbidden: changing features, buffer sizes, source, or rules after seeing results
next_if_no_direct_candidate: Close terrain as a direct depth-signal family and preregister thermal separately.
